verdict.rationale: Milvus's own SDK lets a search call take a list of query vectors and explicitly 'supports batch', so batched operations across many items exist natively. The evidence covers only batch search, not bulk writes, updates, deletes or imports, so the depth of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented bulk insert/upsert/delete across many entities, bulk import tooling, filter-based bulk mutations, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: a list of one or more query vectors, supports batch
